translations.web: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.
translations.bsb: Therefore I want the men everywhere to pray, lifting up holy hands, without anger or dissension.
translations.kjv: I will therefore that men pray every where, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and doubting.
translations.asv: I desire therefore that the men pray in every place, lifting up holy hands, without wrath and disputing.
